notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000063908-26-000035, filed February 24, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-145548, filed April 7, 2026), read on EDGAR. LEADER: Ray Kroc is deceased; the 2025 proxy calls him 'Our founder', so relation is 'founder' (data.js shows the role 'Former CEO'). The 2026 proxy and FY2025 10-K do not mention him, so the leader source stays the 2025 proxy's sentence; neither discloses a Kroc estate, family, foundation or trust holding, so family is null. HOLDERS: the proxy heads its table 'beneficial owners of more than 5% of our common stock outstanding as of December 31, 2025'; Vanguard's and State Street's footnotes give holdings as of December 31, 2025, but BlackRock's still rests on a 13G/A reporting holdings at December 31, 2023, which is stale. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line ($2,056 million); the equity statement shows $2,016 million of treasury stock purchases. GEOGRAPHY: McDonald's reports revenue by its three segments; International Operated Markets covers markets such as Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Spain and the U.K., and the third segment combines developmental-licensee markets (including China and Japan) with corporate activities. Intercompany revenues are eliminated.

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 (the file escapes the apostrophe in the name as \u0027; "o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at September 30, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: McDonald's FY2025 10-K gives only a combined estimate of shareholders of record and beneficial owners (5,100,000 as of January 31, 2026), not a count of holders of record.

source.quote: Our median employee for 2025 is a restaurant crew employee located in Poland and in 2025 had total compensation of $19,020 as calculated in accordance with the Summary Compensation Table rules.

pay.notes: Employees: the 10-K gives a floor ('over 150,000'), recorded as 150,000; it excludes the over two million people who work in franchised restaurants. Payroll: the income statement's 'Payroll & employee benefits' (2,905 million) covers only Company-owned and operated restaurants (support-staff payroll sits in SG&A), so it is not a total staff cost and the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used: a part-time-inclusive restaurant crew employee in Poland, identified by annualizing one month's wages for employees on October 1, 2025 (CEO pay ratio 1,082:1).
